decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Reasons for granting consent: The scheme, subject to conditions, will be in keeping with the architectural and historic character of the Grade II Listed Building.
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted plan 65.2(B), the door glazing and opening details shall be completed in accordance with a scheme to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the relevant part of the works hereby approved is commenced.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted plan 65.2(B), full details of the installation of the underground storage tank including Building Control approval documentation shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the relevant part of the works being commenced. The scheme shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of bay and canopy to first floor rear window, erection of a new detached conservatory in rear garden, installation of a gate and formation of underground water tank to side of house.
